description: Ministry of Hill Country New Villages, Infrastructure & Community Development - The New Villages Development Authority for Plantation Region
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the appointed date for the New Villages Development Authority for Plantation Region Act, No. 32 of 2018 to come into operation. This falls under legal/regulatory matters as it deals with the implementation of a specific Act of Parliament, making it a Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory) classification rather than a government personnel or structural change.
